cost: Inline processing linear text scans plus allocations; paged extraction can scan every section/problem per answer; reachability O(U^3) time and O(U^2) intermediates for U distinct parsed numbers. No runtime improvement claimed.
description: Extract numbered OCR arithmetic stories and whole answers, associate page/chapter keys, and optionally filter by a bounded two-operation numeric reachability heuristic. All execution evidence uses supplied strings.
forward: Extract numbered OCR arithmetic stories and whole answers, associate page/chapter keys, and optionally filter by a bounded two-operation numeric reachability heuristic. All execution evidence uses supplied strings.

main.rs dispatches main_args; extraction reads sorted file paths, then problems -> answer/story helpers -> reachable -> JSON. Paged and OpenStax extraction attach answers by keys before story filtering. Native fixtures exercise string helpers and numeric normalization only.
inverse: Accepted records preserve source book tag and observed numeric answer under the scoped parser. Acceptance is not proof of correct OCR, story semantics, mathematical solvability or external source provenance.

All OCR strings and book/section metadata whose selected records and reachability checks yield an observed tuple. Punctuation, ignored lines and book association ambiguities prevent a unique original.
limitations: Finite synthetic fixtures and partial syntax only; live parser, teacher, external books, heldout and active school state excluded.
